title: Structured event log format
description: Define a JSONL event log format that both Rust and Python implementations emit during game execution. Events: move_validated, state_transition, legal_moves_generated, game_over, visibility_check, random_value, hidden_state_revealed. Each event includes game ID, turn number, player, state hash, and operation-specific fields. Purpose: mechanical diffing between implementations (first divergence = bug), test vector generation, game replay/recording, spec compliance auditing, AI training data. Both implementations must emit identical events for identical inputs.
notes: Event log format must support hash chaining: each entry includes a hash of the previous entry, forming a Merkle chain (same structure as git commits). This enables tamper-evident game records for tournament play. The spec defines the chain format; where the log lives (signed object store, CT-style log, third-party notary) is a deployment decision. Tournament deployments SHOULD write the log to an append-only store.
